# Dominion City Regina

> A Dominion City church in Regina, Saskatchewan. We gather Sundays at
> 10:00 AM at 2144B Broad Street, Regina, SK S4P 1Y5.

Dominion City Regina is part of Dominion City Canada (dominioncitycanada.org),
a church raising leaders that transform society.

## Gatherings

- Sunday Service: every Sunday, 10:00 AM (Central Standard Time), 2144B Broad Street, Regina.
- Believers' Circle: small groups every Friday, 6:30 PM, in East Regina
  (105-2175 Heseltine Rd), West Regina (7-8950 Canola Avenue) and Moose Jaw
  (1242 Vaughan St).

## Contact

- Phone: +1 (639) 997-1522, +1 (639) 525-4711
